Privacy Policy

I take your privacy very seriously.


RSS Bear Hub does not collect any user data, and all sensitive information (passwords and other account information) is stored securely in the local application database on your device.


RSS Bear Hub will use the following permissions to provide you with the service.

- Get network status permission (to determine if the device currently has available network conditions)

- Background service permission (to automatically sync your favorites for you on a regular basis)



Third Party Services

This policy does not apply to third-party services that you use with RSS Bear Hub. You can review the privacy policies of the third-party services you use on their websites
